name: Machines and their systems
description: Computers and devices next to the operating systems that ran on them.
author: codegrave

checkpoints.name: The mainframe era
checkpoints.note: IBM's System/360 (1964) gives business one family of compatible computers. Room-sized machines run banks, airlines and governments, and computing means a terminal on someone else's computer.

checkpoints.name: The home computer boom
checkpoints.note: The Apple II, Commodore 64 and IBM PC bring computers into homes and offices by the million, most with BASIC built in.
